scope: Read-only CPU audit of saved fixed-100 and step-8000 rotating-100 validation arrays. Separate additional fixed case109 historical left-hand-jitter probe. No inference/training/source/checkpoint-selection changes.
severe_local_rotation_definition: Exclude root. Median reference-to-prediction local SO3 geodesic >90deg AND median local error-to-GT increase >60deg; body subset excludes terminal foot/head/wrist joints.

computation.backend: NumPy CPU, identical Gram-Schmidt and FK equations as supervision.py
computation.reason: Torch dynamic loader failed in a separate new process; no environment or library files changed.

limits: Fixed and rotating core panels each contain100 EXO windows with clean/noisy observations, not full VAL/TEST. The additional fixed case109 is separate.
Pooled core panels have no identical physical windows under (dataset,sequence_id,source_first), but share recordings and may have temporal overlap; they are not independent complete-dataset samples.
Worse>0 includes tiny differences and small hidden masks; 20/50/100mm thresholds and count-weighted metrics also provided.
The local rotation thresholds locate strong overcorrection, not every failure or complete physical validity. Terminal wrist rotations may not affect22-joint MPJPE.
Final saved outputs do not causally distinguish backbone, scene feedback, confidence and constraints; matched inference diagnostics still required.
Six-dimensional conditioning checks concern final saved outputs after rotation normalization; they cannot rule out pre-normalization or intermediate DDIM numerical problems.
